initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table and arithmetic checks establish a standardized contrast, but do not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R296-3 to assess whether the contrast identifies the average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Standardizing stratum-specific risk differences to the population Z distribution identifies the causal effect: (250/350)(0.4−0.6) + (100/350)(0.8−0.6) = −0.08571428571428572.
